newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Wooltru interim shr, div surge.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Wooltru interim shr, div surge.

text.p: NOTE - Analysts' earnings predictions ranged between 49.9 cents and 57 cents, while interim dividend forecasts range between 18.5 cents and 21 cents compared to 18 cents.
The group will offer capitalisation shares to shareholders in lieu of the dividend. Details will be distributed on March 14.
Wooltru said that although the trading environment remained demanding, the results for the year should be satisfactory because of tight discipline.
The exceptional items cover losses on the closure of an operation, an insurance claim and profit on the sale of land and buildings.
It plans to list Woolworths and Truworths International on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange later this year, probably in September or October.
